data.name: Venomous Saliva
data.description: As a swift action, you can spit a gout of life-stealing venom onto a weapon you are wielding. The poison lasts for 1 minute or until you make an attack that injures a foe with that weapon. Life-Stealing Venom: Injury; save Fort DC %1;frequency 1/round for 3 rounds; effect 1 Con damage; cure 1 save. You can use the venomous saliva ability %2 times per day.|DomainScalykindDC|DomainScalykindTimes
